title: Isolation precautions

findings.where: Images 1, 3–5, 7, 8, 10–12, 14; contact/droplet rows; facts 2–3; contact/droplet captions and narration
findings.title: Room-placement rules are incorrectly absolute
findings.problem: Contact precautions are presented as requiring a single room or same-pathogen cohort, and droplet precautions allow sharing only with the same pathogen. CDC patient-placement guidance prefers single rooms and supports same-pathogen cohorting, but also permits carefully selected non-cohort roommates when necessary, with infection-prevention assessment and additional safeguards. The repeated 'only' incorrectly excludes that contingency.
findings.fix: Describe single rooms as preferred and same-pathogen cohorting as an alternative. State that when neither is available, infection prevention determines an appropriate placement with additional safeguards. Remove the categorical claim that every shared room must be a same-pathogen cohort.

findings.where: Images 1, 7, 8, 14; transport panel; IsolationDiagram transport text
findings.title: Transport graphic omits 'if tolerated'
findings.problem: The standalone graphic says the client wears a surgical mask without qualification. Fact 8, DESC, the caption and narration all correctly include 'if tolerated'. Students viewing only the inline diagram do not receive that qualification.
findings.fix: Change the visible line to 'The client wears a surgical mask if tolerated.' Preserve the patient-versus-staff PPE distinction without implying that all droplet transport requires staff N95 use.

findings.where: All explainer steps; kit.jsx Frame aria-labelledby/desc and isolation.jsx DESC
findings.title: Accessible image description ignores the active step
findings.problem: Every focused step retains the full overview description. For example, the standard-only step’s image description includes contact, droplet, airborne, transport and C. difficile content that is not displayed. A screen-reader user inspecting the image receives the entire lecture rather than the focused visual explanation.
findings.fix: Provide a step-specific SVG description in player mode, including every focused region. Keep the full description for the inline overview.

assessment: Revise before publication. Room-placement requirements are overstated, the transport graphic drops a safety qualification, and the player’s accessible description does not match its focused steps.
